changelog: Neural Rendering now toggles with Delete; Page Up and Page Down remain XIV zoom keys, and End toggles frame generation.
Frame generation choices now include tested RTX 40 multipliers, an experimental RTX 40 Dynamic mode pending 4090 verification, and experimental RTX 30 2× FSR frame generation.
The frame cap, Dynamic targets and HDR peak brightness follow the active display.
Choose Off, HDR or experimental Scene HDR on supported displays; RTX 30 uses XeFG 2× while Windows HDR is on.
Four resolution-aware Neural Rendering profiles now cover Ultra, Fidelity, Balanced and Performance.
RTX 30 multi-frame-generation unlocks are deferred pending Intel XeSS license clearance.
